# libdrm

The upstream libdrm project publishes no `LICENSE`/`COPYING` file. The MIT
license notice and copyright lines are carried in the headers of its source
files. `LICENSE-header.txt` reproduces verbatim the notice from `xf86drm.c` in
the pinned release 2.4.134 (https://dri.freedesktop.org/libdrm/libdrm-2.4.134.tar.xz).
The Alpine recipe declares the package license as `MIT` (see
`APKBUILD-3.24-stable`).
